model_encoding.mask_models: Declare the same specific model:layer for every condition, including the baseline.
model_encoding.claim: Unique predictive contribution conditional on this readout, representation and matched observation support.

decoder.heldout_mismatch: All fitted readouts save predictions on nonoverlapping mismatched observations.
decoder.report: Per task and story as well as equal-family/source summaries; seeds are repetitions, not participants.
decoder.selection: Three whole-story inner folds, selection seed 11, shared settings across evaluation seeds.
decoder.linear_policy: Fixed learning rate and epochs; no separate tuning.
decoder.null_policy: Same selected learning rate, epochs and seed as matched structured decoder; disrupt training correspondence only.
decoder.trace_policy: Full linked traces only for primary structured context fits used by geometry; all fits retain predictions and weights.
decoder.faithfulness: Heldout query-conditioned primitive-route-selected site replacement versus equal-count seeded random sites; decoder reliance, not neural causality.

geometry.interpretation: Compare matched item distances within independently fitted spaces; report unavailable items and actual shared support.

aggregation.encoding: Paired heldout voxel scores on identical support; report native-cortex and mapped-parcel coverage separately.
aggregation.decoder: Average repeats within query, queries within source/family, families within source, sources within story, then stories. Also retain per-family/story results.
aggregation.geometry: Equal sources within story and equal stories for item signatures; compare RDMs, never average coordinates across fits.
aggregation.population_intervals: Average seeds within participant/story cells; crossed participant/story resampling requires a complete paired panel.
aggregation.multiple_testing: Report all declared models/layers/views and contrasts; labelwise tests use declared BH families, not selected significant subsets.
aggregation.final_story: Evaluate only after development choices are fixed; one final story cannot estimate across-story population uncertainty.

encoding_search: One selected fit using equal weights plus the union of 8 Dirichlet candidates from seeds 11/29/47.
